name: Children’s Magazine and Book Editorial Model
kind: domain-specific editorial workflow and knowledge model

sishu-kishore.poetry_art: Poetic Natural within the approved illustration medium
sishu-kishore.homepage: all current articles in randomized order, followed by other content; Back/Forward restores position
sishu-kishore.cover: full-height art; readable complementary lettering; softening local to words; restrained desktop tilt and flat mobile

author_selection.rotation_decision: User selected strict one-edition gap on 1 November 2026; no consecutive monthly contributions.
author_selection.draft_conflicts: Flag for selection; do not automatically withdraw or reschedule writings.
author_selection.book_scope: Not applied to books, chapters, poetry collections or language editions.

books.source_preservation: Keep original manuscripts/scans and credits; unresolved transcription stays provisional.
books.structure: Preserve chapter, paragraph, stanza, verse-line and comic-panel order.
books.translation: Direct from approved source; preserve meaning, voice and cultural context; review each language independently.
books.illustration: Use full source content, cast/action/prop continuity and full-size anatomy review; propagate approved revisions to every requested output.
books.typography: Language-specific shaping, font coverage and readable live text; preserve approved historical export typography.
books.output_quality: Verify each requested language/format combination separately; do not infer PDF or print quality from web checks.
books.visibility: Respect private and unlisted boundaries; unlisted is direct-link public, not authentication.

learning_policy.unit: contextual correction with before, after, reason, scope and approval evidence

quality_policy.book_release_requires: Book production plan with source inventory, audience/languages, rights/credits, per-language review and per-output evidence.
